snippet.title: DeadCore redux Demo announcement
snippet.description:
#madewithunity  #indiedev  #unity3d #steamdeck 
You can download the Demo and whishlist here if you want to support us! https://s.team/a/3484260

We hope you like this gameplay trailer. What's best is that you can experience it for yourself by playing the free Demo available now on Steam!

DeadCore Redux Features:

New graphics:
Entirely remade in new 3D engine Unity HDRP featuring modern PBR lighting and Volumetrics effects, new 3D models and textures, revamped VFXs and new UI.
Steam Deck support with bespoke visual settings.

New audio:
Complete revamped SFXs, remastered soundtrack and improved audio game mixing for more immersion and clarity!

Gamepads support:
Dedicated game code and UI for game controllers

The “Gateway”:
New gigantic Story level to complete before reaching the game “true” ending

Solo Ranking:
New offline ranking system granting badges for each level based on your performance.

DeadCore Redux is set to be released on Steam around Q3 2025.
